name: i2c-pullups
title: I2C pull-up pair
about: One 4.7 kΩ pull-up on SDA and one on SCL to the bus supply: the value for 100 kHz on a small board (G-11). For Fast mode (400 kHz) 2.2 kΩ.

ports.vcc: the bus supply (the lower one when the devices run from different supplies)

notes: Once per bus. Modules often bring their own pull-ups ("pull": "up" with "pull_ohm" on their pins); parallel pull-ups lower the value, and G-11 adds them up.
The block marks both nets with "bus": "i2c", so that G-11 checks them even when the MCU's pins are called GP4/GP5.
